title: Sewers of Nihilia: Lair tool recovery

zone.name: Sewers of Nihilia: Lair of Trapped Ones

summary: Recover Alej Leraji's tools before his survival timer expires.
overview: Recover Alej Leraji's tools before his survival timer expires.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Clear and search all three tool rooms, then return promptly to Alej.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Give Alej the qualifying seal to populate the tool rooms and start the rescue.
The entrance, cocoon and waterwheel rooms each place a tool on one randomly selected event enemy.
Alej warns after 50 minutes; ten minutes later the event fails if he has not been rescued.
